description: This file defines the sysinfo class for Darwin (macOS) systems, extending BSD common functionality and providing methods to retrieve system information such as CPU details, memory, PCI and IDE device info, network interfaces, filesystems, and system icon. It is part of the phpSysInfo project, specifically tailored for Darwin systems.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class to gather system information for Darwin (macOS) systems, extending BSD common functionality and implementing methods for hardware and system metrics.

methods.name: grab_key
methods.description: Executes 'sysctl' command for a given key and cleans up the output.

methods.name: grab_ioreg
methods.description: Executes 'ioreg' command to retrieve hardware registry info and processes the output.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU-related information such as model, speed, and cache size.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers memory usage and swap information.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Lists mounted filesystems and their details.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename for Darwin system icon.
